title: Receipt writer
hints: `fmt.Fprintf(w, format, args...)` is `Printf` that writes to `w` instead of the terminal. It returns `(n int, err error)` — keep the `err`.
Loop over the items, keep a running `total` in cents, and write each line with `fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s x%d = $%d.%02d\n", ...)`. After each write, `if err != nil { return err }`.

A small helper `dollars(c int) string { return fmt.Sprintf("$%d.%02d", c/100, c%100) }` keeps it tidy. Write `(no items)` first when `len(items) == 0`, and finish with `_, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, "TOTAL = %s\n", dollars(total)); return err`.
